description: Canonical configuration for a GitHub-native Velvet status repository.

theme.description: Presentation theme. Setup writes a complete system theme; hand-written files may override selected roles.

items.description: Public service component. Use name plus url for one default check, or checks for multiple named endpoints.

method.description: Safe HTTP method. Velvet supports GET and HEAD.

expectedStatusCodes.description: Final HTTP status codes that count as healthy. Defaults to only 200.

timeoutMs.description: Absolute request timeout in milliseconds across all redirects. Defaults to 10000.

secret.description: Environment-variable name containing the header value. Secret values never belong in velvet.yml.

items.description: Optional explicit JSON health assertion. Status-only checks do not inspect the response body.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer identifying the response value.
